reason: T0036_v6 confirms the T0036_v5 finding: integrated post-route Fmax is structurally ~155 MHz (v5: 158 MHz at 250 MHz target with WNS=-2.34; v6: 154 MHz at 167 MHz target with WNS=-0.47). Both runs share the same critical path (u_sched/u_vision_fifo BRAM access, ~6.47 ns end-to-end delay) — the routing congestion is a fundamental property of the integrated BD topology, not a constraint-margin issue. T0030 standalone scheduler closes WNS=+0.304 ns at 250 MHz, so the +2.5 ns integration regression is interconnect-driven and is recoverable by pipelining the FIFO address path (Path C, SV change to T0030, ~1 day of human SV+verification work). For the FCCM/DAC submission the v5 numbers stand as the [HW-IMPL] post-route row of Table V: Fmax 158 MHz, DSP=465 (EXACT match to T0036_RETRY/v4 synth — 4-way validation of compute fabric), URAM=299, BRAM=442, LUT=73848, total power 16.16 W (dynamic 2.57 W + static 13.59 W conservative ambient model; real on-board static would be lower, total estimated 12-15 W). Path C pipelining is documented in §VII Future Work as the route to recover 250 MHz Fmax for camera-ready.
